selection.reason: The frozen rule does not establish sufficient stable evidence to replace the H default.

ratio_summary.scope: Descriptive sum ratio on the recorded eligible original-complete pairs; the full frozen gate is required for implementation selection.

legacy_policy_ratio_summary.scope: descriptive current-environment single paired repeat; no uncertainty interval or significance claim

historical_V3.role: Separate historical implementation observation; no policy-removal causal ratio or D/G/Stream/G inference.

interpretation.complete_cost: graph load and structural preparation + all actual full request times
interpretation.solver_timers: overlap exclusive service phases; never added to those phases
interpretation.partial_cost: saved work/progress only; no complete Q4 ratio
interpretation.cold_tail_ids: cold batch rows sent to the common endpoint classifier, not total generated or unique candidates
interpretation.candidate_rhs: request role counter, distinct from total worker scalar_rhs
interpretation.access_counters: H row pops and G block/leaf/cursor counters retain separate meanings
interpretation.memory: worker ru_maxrss through final pre-serialization checkpoint; supervisor 100ms RSS/VMS sampled maxima; neither is exact object memory
interpretation.statistics: three prespecified repetitions of six previously observed streams; no confidence interval, significance or new-input generalization
interpretation.numerical_verification: exact logged same-method semantic checks; no new independent full-catalog numerical replay
interpretation.stop: one frozen batch; no adaptive repeats, inputs, precision, resolver or backend changes
